## Commit 1 (最旧的 - bus clk重构)

```
clk: rk3576: refactor bus clock registration into AXI/AHB/APB subsystems

Separate the bus root clock registration from the monolithic
rk3576_clk_register_tree() into three dedicated functions:

- rk3576_clk_register_axi(): Register AXI (aclk) domain roots with
  mux+divider chains for aclk_top_biu, aclk_bus_root, and
  aclk_center_root. Each root feeds DMA controllers and high-bandwidth
  peripherals.

- rk3576_clk_register_ahb(): Register AHB (hclk) domain roots as pure
  muxes for hclk_top_biu, hclk_bus_root, hclk_center_root, and
  hclk_audio_root. These parent FSPI, SAI/PDM bus interface gates.

- rk3576_clk_register_apb(): Register APB (pclk) domain roots for
  pclk_top_root, pclk_bus_root, pclk_center_root, and pclk_pmu0_root.
  These parent UART, I2C, PWM, timer, and PMU-domain peripherals.

All mux/divider configurations follow RK3576 TRM Chapter 2 register
maps (CLKSEL_CONxx). Parent clocks are sourced from GPLL/CPLL/AUPLL
post-dividers registered in rk3576_clk_register_pll_factors().

Signed-off-by: yunline <yunline@foxmail.com>
```

---

## Commit 2 (litcore clk实现)

```
clk: rk3576: implement LITCORE_CRU clock tree for little-core cluster

Add complete clock tree support for the little-core (LIT) power domain
at 0x27240000 (LITCORE_CRU), covering CPU cluster clocks and their
parent selection logic.

Key clocks registered:
- clk_lpll: FRACPLL in CCI_CRU (0x27248000) with runtime rate
  calculation using FOUT = ((m + k/65536) * FIN) / (p * 2^s)
- clk_litcore_src_sel: 2-bit mux selecting lpll/gpll/pvtpll source
- clk_litcore_src_div: 5-bit post-divider for litcore source
- clk_litcore_sel: 2-bit mux selecting src_out/pvtpll/clean path
- clk_litcore: CPU core clock gate (GATE_CON00[5])
- aclk_m_litcore: AXI matrix clock with divider
- pclk_litcore_root: APB root clock with gpll/lpll mux + divider
- pclk_dbg_litcore: Debug APB clock gate

Register definitions added to rk3576_cru.h:
- RK3576_LITCORECRU_MODE_CON
- RK3576_LITCORECRU_CLKSEL_CON(n)
- RK3576_LITCORECRU_GATE_CON(n)
- RK3576_LITCORECRU_SOFTRST_CON(n)
- RK3576_CCICRU_LPLL_CON(n) for LPLL configuration

The PVTPLL (Process-Voltage-Temperature monitoring PLL) is registered
with NULL parent and 0 Hz to indicate its dynamic, non-stable nature.

Reference: RK3576 TRM Chapter 2.11 "LITCORE_CRU" and 2.12 "CCI_CRU".

Signed-off-by: yunline <yunline@foxmail.com>
```

---

## Commit 3 (最新的 - fix issues)

```
clk: rk3576: fix center-root mux/divider register split and LPLL modeling

Two critical fixes for RK3576 clock tree accuracy:

1. Fix aclk_center_root register mapping:
   The mux (aclk_center_root_sel) and divider
   (aclk_center_root_div) reside in DIFFERENT CLKSEL registers per TRM:
   - Mux @ CLKSEL_CON168[7:5] (was incorrectly at CON167)
   - Divider @ CLKSEL_CON167[13:9]
   Unlike aclk_top_biu/aclk_bus_root where both sit in the same
   register, center-root requires split register access.

2. Model LPLL as FRACPLL instead of fixed-rate:
   - Replace clk_register_fixed_rate() with clk_register() using
     g_rk3576_fracpll_ops for runtime rate calculation
   - Add RK3576_CCICRU_LPLL_CON(n) definitions in rk3576_cru.h
   - LPLL lives in CCI_CRU domain (0x27248000) and feeds little-core
     cluster; bootloader owns initial configuration but OS needs
     accurate rate reporting via FRACPLL formula

3. Correct aclk_top_biu mux bit position:
   - Changed from bit[6:5] to bit[5:4] per TRM CLKSEL_CON09

4. Clarify PVTPLL documentation:
   - Document that PVTPLL is NOT a stable clock source
   - Used for performance monitoring and DVFS feedback only

Signed-off-by: yunline <yunline@foxmail.com>
```

PWM, timer, and PMU peripherals.
